yamlCheck.dateAnchor: February 2, February 4, approximately February 14, and March 8 are spoken. January and morning are spoken at opening; January 30 and all years come from YAML.
yamlCheck.explanation: Two nights of opening flight followed by the next-day February 2 meeting fit a January 30 opening. A further day and February 4 departure are narrated, followed by 8.5 days flying plus 1.5 days at Orenlas and approximate February 14 arrival. Downtime reaches spoken March 8. Sleep is interrupted that night without an established midnight crossing, so March 9 is possible but unverified; the metadata end supplies no elapsed day.

boundaryUncertainties.reading: The closing awakening is on the night following March 8 afternoon; its civil date is open.

alternatives.reading: Waking occurs before midnight on March 8.
Waking occurs after midnight on March 9, compatible with YAML.
